name: What Are The Odds That All MY Classmates Are Emotionally Distant Indie Game Scalie Girls?
source: Take on the role of Anon, some variety of naked gray potato man on a quest to court one of three gorgeous girls from the indie hits you've come to expect! The Grumpy One, The Snooty One, The Goth One! One of them isn't even out yet!
translation: 扮演Anon的角色，一个赤身裸体的灰色土豆男人，追求你所期待的独立热门游戏中的三个漂亮女孩之一！脾气暴躁、傲慢、哥特！其中一张还没出来呢！
